_comment: Claude Code PreToolUse gate hook for the dual-bridge architecture. NOT auto-active: installing it is a deliberate operator step (global rule §12). Merge the 'hooks' block into .claude/settings.json (project) or ~/.claude/settings.json (user). The matcher is a regex OR-list; mcp__.* gates every MCP tool (fail-closed). The gate_cli reads the PreToolUse event on stdin and writes a hookSpecificOutput decision on stdout. Workspace resolves from --workspace, else the event cwd, else CWD.
